title: Windows source spool lacks native ACL gate while retaining bearer recording URLs
evidence: STATIC OBSERVED, runtime RED NOT EXECUTED. Current source-jobs.ts SHA256 8a62f468831cebe14b2b56d2d1b249fb59b7ba13263e2adde64b4f36eb218e59 and jobs/store.ts 677319c73124da30f60da3322f2dae2e1a83e18d48514e1985f6d5d6adf72fa8 construct HostingJournal without verifyPrivateDirectory/verifyPrivateArtifact. HostingJournal directory/regularFile checks permissions only when process.platform !== 'win32'. enqueue stores canonical query-free Zoom /rec/share/<bearer-token> privately; spool name filtering/ancestry alone do not establish Windows ACL privacy.

reproductions.input: On Windows, source spool root ACL owner=current identity, current identity FullControl, unrelated SID Allow Read; enqueue tenant-a/actor-a URL https://zoom.us/rec/share/fixturebearer with idempotencyKey windows-acl-root and server approval matching actor-a.
reproductions.expected: Refuse before URL journal append and before acquisition/provider call; unrelated identity must never obtain the bearer input.
reproductions.execution: NOT RUN; use deterministic native ACL reader seam for corpus, plus separately attributable actual Windows native ACL receipt.

reproductions.input: Root privately owned; pre-existing hashed tenant-a directory permits unrelated SID Read. Same approved URL, idempotencyKey windows-acl-tenant.
Root and hashed tenant directory private; existing audit.jsonl ACL permits unrelated SID Read. Poll/claim/next enqueue must not trust that journal.
reproductions.expected: Refuse rather than exposing/reading/appending unsafe bearer artifact; zero acquisition/provider.

reproductions.input: Spool or tenant artifact owner is unrelated SID even if only current identity has an explicit Allow rule.

controls.input: Actual current identity owner or approved SYSTEM/Admin ownership; only current identity/SYSTEM/Administrators Allow; explicit current identity FullControl, no current identity Deny; pinned local directory and artifact.
controls.expected: Allows enqueue/reconstruction without acquisition or provider call; native receipt covers actual path.

controls.input: POSIX current-uid directory 0700, single-link artifact 0600, no symlink.

notes: Root explicitly authorized this unique lane shard and ID. No shared ledger, approval-boundary or ACL mutation performed. Existing private-acl.ts provides read-only bounded native proof and should be reused/wired or equivalent enforceable gate supplied.

title: OnAir session account authority is not bound to tenant and approved event before acquisition
evidence: STATIC OBSERVED, runtime RED NOT EXECUTED. publicOnairPage(env.LKB_ONAIR_COOKIE_HEADER) feeds one global account cookie to every OnAir event input. Existing job approval is minted from ingest-authenticated request; source-jobs authorizeExecution checks actor/key lifecycle and trusted tenant allowlist, with no visible OnAir account-owner/event binding. Tenant allowlisting alone does not prove source-account authority for a particular protected event.

reproductions.input: Trusted worker tenants [tenant-a,tenant-b], global OnAir cookie representing account-a; tenant-b/actor-b submits https://cloudonair.withgoogle.com/events/account-a-only and receives ordinary server approval.
reproductions.expected: Refuse before cookie-bearing page request or any downstream acquisition/provider; zero page/tool/provider latch counts.
reproductions.execution: NOT RUN; deterministic transport/page latch only, no real cookies/providers.

reproductions.input: tenant-a valid ingest actor and event approval exist, but OnAir session account has no explicit trusted owner/binding.
OnAir session owner explicitly tenant-a, but request event is different from the immutable approved event set or event-specific approval.
reproductions.expected: Refuse before page/tool/provider even with valid ingest scope.

reproductions.input: Queue approved under account-a/tenant-a/event-one binding; before execution trusted binding is removed, changes account/tenant or no longer authorizes event-one.
reproductions.expected: Fresh worker check refuses before page/tool/provider; original immutable job must not silently inherit new source authority.

controls.input: Current trusted account-owner tenant-a binding explicitly authorizes exact canonical event-one; actor-a still active and same immutable approved input.
controls.expected: May invoke deterministic approved page/tool/provider seams; actual source/host run remains separately required.

controls.input: Public event-one resolver without any source-account cookie, approved tenant/actor source input.
controls.expected: Public path may proceed without claiming authenticated source-account proof; no cookie forwarded.

notes: Root explicitly authorized this unique shard and ID. This records an observed missing source-account security boundary, not a live cross-tenant disclosure or fabricated RED result. Shared AI-provider key ownership is distinct from protected source-session authority.
